decisions.reason: A materials management module extends the firm's core practice-management software and draws on its deep knowledge of dental workflows, so the firm can read early user feedback and improve the module with its in-house developers, even though it is only briefly mentioned on the website.

The KIM secure messaging client is part of the mandatory telematics infrastructure, builds directly on the firm's long regulatory and health-IT expertise, and is actively developed further, as the KIM 1.5 update shows, so dropping it is very unlikely.
